title: Lazy Sunday Syrian Lamb Pasta
description: A tangy and flavorful Syrian dish featuring lamb and tagliatelle, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this recipe is egg-free-friendly and features a rich braise.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pomegranate molasses, salt, black pepper, and sumac, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
While the lamb is cooking, cook the tagliatelle according to the package instructions.
To serve, place the cooked tagliatelle on a plate and top with the lamb and sauce.
